allow: PowerShell($paths = @\("C:\\Program Files\\dotnet\\dotnet.exe","C:\\Program Files \(x86\)\\dotnet\\dotnet.exe","$env:LOCALAPPDATA\\Microsoft\\dotnet\\dotnet.exe","$env:USERPROFILE\\.dotnet\\dotnet.exe"\); foreach\($p in $paths\){ if\(Test-Path $p\){ Write-Output "FOUND: $p" } }; Write-Output "---"; Get-Command dotnet -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)
